part.text:
I found the red ball and walked up to it. The robot is now crouched in rest mode, roughly 0.3 m from the ball and facing it.

The ball was off to the left of the starting direction, past a black suitcase. The last camera image shows it near the robot's feet, a little left of center. I didn't measure the exact distance or do a final alignment, so the facing is approximate.
